test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which year did the Constitution of India come into force?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1950.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Republic is governed in terms of the Constitution of India which was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on **26th November 1949 **and **effective on 26th January 1950.**
 
• A Constitution is a** set of rules and regulations** guiding the administration of a country.
 
• The constitution of India is the **structure for political principles**, procedures and powers of the government. 
 
• It is as well the longest constitution in the world with** 395 articles and 12 schedules.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c6d275440825bd91b69b031c5f65356140d9e400bfa3f3f4837ac5b9481d06f.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

​** __Qualities of the Indian Constitution are given below:__**

 
• Lengthiest Written Constitution.

 
• Blend of Rigidity and Flexibility.
 
• Drawn from Various Sources.
 
• Rule Of Law.
 
• Integrated and Independent Judiciary.
